name: Hadad
description: King living at the time of United Monarchy

points: Esau was always the first hater and enemy of Israel, comforting himself in the thought of killing us. When Hadad heard David and Joab were dead, he sought to return to his own country.

note.label: 1 Kings 11: Solomon's Strange Wives and the Kingdom Torn
